name: NewAge Products
note: Back to not rated yet (source audit, 2026-09-26): the only claim cited Fast Retailing's shareholder page, which is about another company, and no source links NewAge Products to Xinjiang cotton.

Rating note: NewAge Products is privately held (Toronto-based); no state stake. However, as a consumer goods manufacturer, its supply chain carries documented forced-labour exposure from Xinjiang cotton (per UFLPA detentions and Fast Retailing disclosures), triggering 'concern' on conduct grounds.
